title: Convert web application to mobile app format

requirements.text: Configure the application for mobile app deployment by adding Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities including a web manifest file with appropriate app icons, theme colors matching the store's earthy palette, display mode set to 'standalone', and orientation set to 'portrait'. Include all required icon sizes for iOS and Android.

quotes: Convert it into a app From Web

acceptanceCriteria: Web manifest file is created with app name 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point'
Multiple icon sizes are provided (192x192, 512x512 minimum)
Display mode is set to 'standalone' for app-like experience
Theme color matches the store's warm earthy color scheme
Orientation is configured for optimal mobile viewing

requirements.text: Add a service worker to enable offline functionality and app installation prompts. The service worker should cache critical assets (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, product images) and implement a cache-first strategy for static resources and network-first strategy for API calls.

quotes: Convert it into a app From Web

acceptanceCriteria: Service worker is registered in the main application entry point
Critical application assets are cached on installation
App can display cached content when offline
Users receive installation prompts on supported mobile browsers

requirements.text: Optimize the mobile experience by enhancing touch interactions, improving button sizes for finger-friendly tap targets (minimum 44x44px), adding touch gestures for cart drawer, and ensuring all interactive elements are easily accessible on mobile screens.

quotes: Convert it into a app From Web

acceptanceCriteria: All buttons and interactive elements meet minimum touch target size of 44x44px
Cart drawer supports swipe gestures for opening and closing
Touch feedback is provided for all interactive elements
Mobile navigation is optimized for one-handed use

requirements.text: Update the HTML meta tags to include mobile-specific viewport configuration, Apple mobile web app capabilities, and Android app configuration for proper mobile app behavior when installed on home screens.

quotes: Convert it into a app From Web

acceptanceCriteria: Viewport meta tag is configured with width=device-width, initial-scale=1
Apple mobile web app capable meta tags are added
Status bar styling is configured for iOS
Android theme color is set to match app design

constraints: Maintain all existing functionality including authentication, cart, ordering, and admin panel
Preserve the warm, earthy visual design and branding
Ensure the app remains accessible via web browsers as well as installable as a mobile app
Do not require native app store deployment - focus on Progressive Web App approach
nonGoals: Native iOS or Android app development
Native device features like camera, GPS, or push notifications
Complete offline functionality for all features

required: App icon with store logo for mobile devices featuring the shopkeeper illustration and store name, suitable for home screen display (app-icon-192.dim_192x192.png)
Large app icon with store logo for mobile devices featuring the shopkeeper illustration and store name, optimized for high-resolution displays (app-icon-512.dim_512x512.png)
Apple touch icon with store logo for iOS devices featuring the shopkeeper illustration and store name (apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png)
